mapper.update: UPDATE comment_like SET active=#{active},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND active <> #{active}
UPDATE comment_like SET first_notified=1,updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND active=1 AND first_notified=0
